# Folded MSC integration fixtures

These are copies of `tools/profile/fixtures/folded_msc/f{3,5,7}_fed_p1e-3.stim`,
generated by the research reconstruction in `tools/profile/folded_msc.py`.
They transcribe the fold-transversal construction of Takada, Bartlett, and
Williamson, arXiv:2609.16929v1. The reconstruction sources and validation are
recorded in `tools/profile/research/folded_msc.md`, `folded_msc_f5.md`, and
`folded_protocol_f7.md`.

They cover injection, growth, cultivation checks, and fictitious error
detection with a noiseless final logical measurement. They exclude escape,
fictitious error correction, and a decoder. Sequential CSS extraction uses
X checks then Z checks and ascending data index within each check; the paper
does not uniquely specify that ordering. These are not author-supplied files
or a reproduction of the paper's reported logical error coefficients.

Tests strip annotations, change noise rates, rename qubits, and mutate gates
to exercise recognition from actual instructions. Production compilation does
not load these files.
